messages:
alex: Quick sync — postmortem consolidation from the 3/15 infra incident. We shipped the initial postmortem but we still need: (1) runbook triage steps clarified, (2) escalation path unambiguous, (3) owners + deadlines for remediation items, and (4) a short recurring check to catch the eviction pattern earlier. Can folks volunteer to take specific runbook/playbook edits?
maria: I can draft the runbook changes for triage steps. I'll include exact commands and the playbook decision tree. Need an owner for escalation matrix (who calls infra oncall -> exec notify).
lee: I can take the triage steps edit. Will add the exact kubectl and metrics queries. Suggestion: add an explicit `check-kv-cache-hitratio` step and the command snippet below.
lee: ```sh
# quick KV cache hitratio check
kubectl exec -n inference svc/metrics -c exporter -- curl -s localhost:9100/metrics | grep kv_cache_hitratio
```
jordan-oncall: I'll own escalation matrix updates. Noticed ambiguity in who calls infra vs platform oncall during cross-zone capacity loss. Will add a clear RACI and emergency phone roster. Also will add an autodial fallback if pager fails.
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4721: "Runbook edits for 3/15 incident (triage + escalation)" assigned to maria, lee, jordan-oncall. Due 2025-04-04.
kate: Thanks — can we mark anything that requires customer-visible follow-up? We should flag those items so support/product know to craft comms if needed.
lee: +1. For the triage step I'll include a short repro snippet and the query to detect early eviction pattern. ETA EOD tomorrow for the PR.
maria: I'll draft the PR today with the decision tree and add unit-test-like steps for someone to validate during drills. Will attach monitoring alert queries and links to dashboards.
jordan-oncall: Also adding a canary probe to the dedicated pool:
```yaml
readinessProbe:
  exec:
    command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "curl -f http://localhost:8080/health || exit 2"]
  periodSeconds: 60
```
This should catch slow eviction cycles early.
ops-bot: Linked INF-4721 -> INF-4724 (canary probe task) and created subtask INF-4725 (escalation roster update).
alex: Nice. Owner recap: lee -> triage steps PR by EOD tomorrow, maria -> runbook decision tree PR today, jordan-oncall -> escalation matrix + phone roster by end of week, ops-bot -> tickets created. Kate please flag any customer-facing items; if none, we'll keep internal comms.
kate: I'll review this afternoon and flag anything public.
lee: ack :thumbsup:  
maria: filing PR now, will ping here when ready.
jordan-oncall: will update the playbook page and notify oncall rotation. Also scheduling a 2-week follow-up to validate the changes and watch for recurrence.
alex: Schedule that 2-week follow-up as a recurring calendar invite and add a short checklist to the runbook for the follow-up. Once PRs land, we'll close INF-4721 and mark owners in the playbook. Thanks everyone.
